methods.name: Sharp RD: local polynomial with CCT (2014) bias correction and robust variance, given bandwidths

quantities: conventional and robust SE (NN with nnmatch 1/3/5 and tie groups, HC0-HC3)

deviations.note: p2a pools the cutoff estimates by a weighted average, pinned to that formula in causal_rdbw.json (rd_multi_selected); rdmulti::rdmc's pooled estimate is rdrobust on the normalised score x - c, a different estimator, and rdmulti is not installed

methods.name: RD plot: variance-mimicking evenly spaced bins (esmv, esmvpr under mass points) or bins by hand, binned means and the global polynomial on each side
methods.reference: rdrobust::rdplot(y, x, c, p, nbins) 4.0.0 (binselect = 'esmv', masspoints = 'adjust', kernel = 'uni')
quantities: bin midpoints, lower and upper breaks
bin means of x and y
defaults, mass points, nbins, p = 2, cutoff 0.2
methods.tolerance: validation/README.md, n = 1000: coefficients and means 1e-8 relative, counts and J exact

deviations.quantity: the last bin of a side
deviations.note: R's seq() can stop one rounding step short of max(x), so rdplot puts max(x) into an extra bin with no break and no midpoint (4 of the 5 settings of rdplot_sim); p2a closes the last bin at max(x), and the case compares the bins with each such bin merged into the one before it
